format: ModelOpt MIXED_PRECISION, quantization-aware distilled: routed experts NVFP4 (group 16, lossless CSF-compressed block scales), Gated DeltaNet / attention / shared-expert projections MXFP8 (E4M3 + UE8M0 per 32), PLE n-gram embedding NVFP4, MTP experts W4A16 NVFP4, ViT MXFP8 + W4A16 NVFP4, lm_head and embeddings BF16
why: NVIDIA's own quantization is preferred. Their FP4-Local release is distilled against the BF16 model (GPQA Diamond 91.5 vs 92.2, ToolEvalBench 88.7 vs 89.4 on its card), 28 GiB smaller than their post-training-quantized nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 (fc694b54, 123.6 GiB, the RC16 default), and its MXFP8 backbone halves the bytes a decode step reads. The engine still loads the NVFP4 checkpoint.
